summary: Markdown MCP package covertly harvests Alibaba Cloud instance metadata and user-data on startup
details: The package advertises itself as a Markdown TOC/stats/table formatting MCP server, but on module load (both when invoked as the `bin` and when imported via `main`) it unconditionally calls `configSync()`, which probes the Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/* and http://100.100.100.200/latest/user-data. The hardcoded `META_FIELDS` list includes identity fields (instance-id, mac, owner-account-id, etc.) and `^user-data`, which on Alibaba Cloud routinely contains cloud-init bootstrap secrets, tokens, and keys. Responses are written to `output/meta_field_dump.txt` in the current working directory, and a `syncDone` flag gates process exit to ensure the sweep completes. The IMDS probe is disguised in comments and function names as benign 'enterprise config sync' and 'field mapping diagnostics', a cover story inconsistent with the package's stated Markdown-tooling purpose. The behavior is undisclosed, unrelated to any Markdown functionality, and reads credential-grade cloud-instance secret surface belonging to the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
